articles.title_en: When the markets get CO.V.I.D: COntagion, Viruses, and Information Diffusion
articles.title_cn: 当市场遭遇CO.V.I.D：传染、病毒与信息扩散
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the exposure of major financial markets to news shocks about global contagion risk while accounting for local epidemic conditions. For a wide cross section of countries, we construct a novel dataset comprising (i) announcements related to COVID19 and (ii) high-frequency data on epidemic news diffused through Twitter (Hassan et al., 2019’s methodology). We provide novel empirical evidence about financial dynamics both around epidemic announcements and at daily/intra-daily frequencies. Analysis of contagion data and social media activity about COVID19 suggest that the market price of contagion risk is significant.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在考虑当地流行病状况的同时，量化了主要金融市场对全球传染风险新闻冲击的暴露程度。对于广泛的跨国截面，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包括（i）与COVID19相关的公告和（ii）通过Twitter传播的流行病新闻高频数据（采用Hassan等人，2019的方法）。我们提供了关于流行病公告前后以及日度/日内频率金融动态的新颖实证证据。对传染数据和关于COVID19的社交媒体活动的分析表明，传染风险的市场价格是显著的。

articles.title_en: Debtor income manipulation in consumer credit contracts
articles.title_cn: 消费信贷合同中的债务人收入操纵
articles.abstract_en: We show that forcing insolvent consumer debtors to repay a larger fraction of debt causes them to strategically manipulate the data they report to creditors. Exploiting a policy change that required insolvent debtors to increase debt repayments at an arbitrary income cutoff, we document that some debtors reduce reported income to just below this cutoff to avoid the higher repayment. Those debtors who manipulate income have a lower probability of default on their repayment plans, consistent with having access to hidden income. We estimate this strategic manipulation costs creditors 12% to 36% of their total payout per filing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，迫使无力偿债的消费债务人偿还更大比例的债务会导致他们策略性地操纵向债权人报告的数据。利用一项政策变化，该政策要求在任意收入临界点处无力偿债的债务人增加债务偿还，我们记录到一些债务人将报告收入降低至略低于该临界点以避免更高的偿还额。那些操纵收入的债务人在其偿还计划上违约的概率较低，这与他们能够获得隐藏收入相一致。我们估计这种策略性操纵使债权人每次申报的总支付额损失12%至36%。

articles.title_en: Financial constraints, cash flow timing patterns, and asset prices
articles.title_cn: 财务约束、现金流时间模式与资产价格
articles.abstract_en: We show that firms collect almost 70% of their cash flows in the second half of the fiscal year, and that firms that collect more cash by year-end earn a 6.8% higher per annum risk premium and save more cash. We rationalize these facts in a quantitative investment-based asset pricing model. Immediate cash payments negatively affect profitability, but reduce equity financing costs by increasing information transparency. Financially constrained firms optimally collect more cash at year-end when firms’ performance attracts more attention and information transparency is more valuable. Such behavior further results in greater exposure to aggregate productivity and financial shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，企业在财政年度下半年收回了近70%的现金流，并且在年底收回更多现金的企业每年获得6.8%更高的风险溢价，并储蓄更多现金。我们在一个定量的基于投资的资产定价模型中合理化这些事实。即时现金支付对盈利能力产生负面影响，但通过提高信息透明度降低了股权融资成本。财务受限的企业在年底企业业绩更受关注且信息透明度更有价值时，最优地收回更多现金。这种行为进一步导致对总生产率和金融冲击的更大暴露。

articles.title_cn: 基于金融中介的股票期限结构
articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate that a financial intermediary-based asset pricing model offers a compelling explanation for a new set of conditional moments of equity term structure and convenience yields. The model’s key mechanism is that the time-varying tightness of intermediaries’ leverage constraints drives significant mean reversion in the price of risk. This model guides us in devising a novel empirical methodology to estimate the tightness of these constraints (i.e., the Relative Tightness Index) from cross-sectional returns of various asset classes. Our findings affirm that this measure significantly drives the dynamics of equity yield slope and convenience yields, both empirically and quantitatively.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，基于金融中介的资产定价模型为股票期限结构和便利收益的一组新的条件矩提供了有力的解释。该模型的关键机制是，中介杠杆约束的时变紧度驱动了风险价格的显著均值回归。该模型指导我们设计了一种新颖的实证方法，从不同资产类别的横截面收益中估计这些约束的紧度（即相对紧度指数）。我们的研究结果证实，该指标在实证和定量上均显著驱动了股票收益率斜率与便利收益的动态变化。

articles.title_en: Regulatory arbitrage or random errors? Implications of race prediction algorithms in fair lending analysis
articles.title_cn: 监管套利还是随机误差？公平贷款分析中种族预测算法的含义
articles.abstract_en: When race is not directly observed, regulators and analysts commonly predict it using algorithms based on last name and address. In small business lending—where regulators assess fair lending law compliance using the Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) algorithm—we document large prediction errors among Black Americans. The errors bias measured racial disparities in loan approval rates downward by 43%, with greater bias for traditional vs. fintech lenders. Regulation using self-identified race would increase lending to Black borrowers, but also shift lending toward affluent areas because errors correlate with socioeconomics. Overall, using race proxies in policymaking and research presents challenges.
articles.abstract_cn: 当种族未被直接观测时，监管者和分析师通常使用基于姓氏和地址的算法来预测种族。在小企业贷款中——监管者使用贝叶斯改进姓氏地理编码（BISG）算法评估公平贷款法合规性——我们记录了美国黑人中较大的预测误差。这些误差使贷款批准率中测得的种族差异向下偏误了43%，传统贷款机构相比金融科技贷款机构的偏误更大。使用自我认同的种族进行监管将增加对黑人借款人的贷款，但也会将贷款转向富裕地区，因为误差与社会经济状况相关。总体而言，在政策制定和研究中使用种族代理变量带来了挑战。

articles.title_en: Crowdsourcing peer information to change spending behavior
articles.title_cn: 众包同伴信息以改变消费行为
articles.abstract_en: We isolate the information channel of peer effects in consumption in a setting that excludes a role for common shocks or social pressure—a spending panel paired with crowdsourced information about anonymous “peers” elicited at different times. Consumers converge to peers’ spending, and more so when peer signals are more informative. Convergence is asymmetric: within 12 months of information provision, overspenders close 17% and underspenders 5% of their gap relative to peers. We exploit the quasi-random assignment to peer groups in an instrumental-variable strategy and implement an experiment for external validity. Our results are consistent with information-based theories of overconsumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个排除了共同冲击或社会压力作用的设定中，隔离了消费中同伴效应的信息渠道——一个消费面板与在不同时间获取的关于匿名“同伴”的众包信息配对。消费者向同伴的消费水平趋同，并且当同伴信号更具信息性时，这种趋同更为明显。趋同是不对称的：在信息提供后的12个月内，过度消费者缩小了其与同伴差距的17%%，而消费不足者缩小了5%%。我们利用工具变量策略中同伴组的准随机分配，并实施了一项实验以检验外部有效性。我们的结果与基于信息的过度消费理论一致。

articles.title_en: When failure is an option: Fragile liquidity in over-the-counter markets
articles.title_cn: 当失败是一种选择：场外交易市场中的脆弱流动性
articles.abstract_en: Markets can give false impressions of liquidity and stability if failed attempts to trade are ignored. For collateralized loan obligations, we quantify this bias by estimating the total cost of immediacy (TCI) which incorporates failure rates and failure costs. TCI is substantially higher than the observed cost, 0.3–3.8% versus 0.04–0.12% across credit-quality tranches because trade failures are frequent, failure costs are large, and failure costs and rates are correlated. TCI is almost double the realized gains from trade for low-rated tranches. Overall, auction-based over-the-counter markets become illiquid and fragile, especially during stressful periods for low-rated assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果忽略失败的交易尝试，市场可能会给人流动性和稳定性的错误印象。对于抵押贷款债务，我们通过估计即时性总成本（TCI）来量化这种偏差，该成本包含了失败率和失败成本。TCI显著高于观察到的成本，在不同信用质量分层中为0.3-3.8%对比0.04-0.12%，因为交易失败频繁，失败成本高昂，且失败成本与失败率相关。对于低评级分层，TCI几乎是已实现交易收益的两倍。总体而言，基于拍卖的场外交易市场变得缺乏流动性且脆弱，尤其是在低评级资产的压力时期。

articles.title_en: The passive ownership share is double what you think it is
articles.title_cn: 被动持股比例是你想象的两倍
articles.abstract_en: Each time a stock gets added to or dropped from an index, we ask: “How much money would have to be tracking that index to explain the huge spike in rebalancing volume we observe on reconstitution day?” While index funds held 16% of the US stock market in 2021, we put the overall passive ownership share at 33.5%. Our headline number is twice as large because it reflects index funds as well as other kinds of passive investors, such as institutional investors with internally managed index portfolios and active managers who are closet indexing.
articles.abstract_cn: 每当一只股票被加入或剔除出指数时，我们都会问：“需要有多少资金跟踪该指数，才能解释我们在指数调整日观察到的再平衡交易量的巨大飙升？”虽然指数基金在2021年持有美国股市的16%，但我们认为总体被动持股比例为33.5%。我们的头条数字是其两倍，因为它反映了指数基金以及其他类型的被动投资者，例如内部管理指数投资组合的机构投资者和进行隐性指数化的主动型基金经理。

articles.title_en: Real effects of supplying safe private money
articles.title_cn: 供给安全私人货币的实际效应
articles.abstract_en: Privately issued money often bears default risk, which creates transaction frictions when used as a medium of exchange. The late 19th century US provides a unique context to evaluate the real effects of supplying a new type of money that is safe from default. We measure the local change in “monetary” transaction frictions with a market access approach derived from general equilibrium trade theory. Consistent with theories hypothesizing that lowering transaction frictions benefits the traded and inputs-intensive sectors, we find an increase in traded goods production, in the share of manufacturing output and employment, and in innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 私人发行的货币通常带有违约风险，这在使用其作为交换媒介时会产生交易摩擦。19世纪末的美国为评估供给一种无违约风险的新型货币的实际效应提供了独特背景。我们采用源自一般均衡贸易理论的市场准入方法来衡量“货币”交易摩擦的局部变化。与降低交易摩擦有利于贸易和投入密集型部门的理论假设一致，我们发现贸易品生产增加，制造业产出和就业份额上升，以及创新活动增多。

articles.title_en: The diversification and welfare effects of robo-advising
articles.title_cn: 机器人投顾的多元化与福利效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the diversification and welfare effects of a large US robo-advisor on the portfolios of previously self-directed investors and document five facts. First, robo-advice reshapes portfolios by increasing indexing and reducing home bias, number of assets held, and fees. Second, these portfolio changes contribute to higher Sharpe ratios. Third, those who benefit most from robo-advice are investors who did not have high exposure to equities or indexing and had poorer diversification levels. Fourth, robo-advice decreases the time investors dedicate to managing their investments. Fifth, those investors who benefit most are more likely to join the service and not quit it.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一家大型美国机器人投顾对先前自主投资的投资者投资组合的多元化和福利效应，并记录了五个事实。第一，机器人投顾通过增加指数化投资、减少本土偏好、持有资产数量和费用来重塑投资组合。第二，这些投资组合变化有助于提高夏普比率。第三，从机器人投顾中获益最多的是那些原本对股票或指数化投资敞口不高且多元化水平较差的投资者。第四，机器人投顾减少了投资者用于管理投资的时间。第五，获益最多的投资者更有可能加入该服务且不会退出。

articles.title_en: Tiny trades, big questions: Fractional shares
articles.title_cn: 微小交易，重大问题：零碎股
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates fractional share trading. We develop a latency-based method for identifying a large sample of fractional share trades. We find that high-priced stocks, meme stocks, IPOs, SPACs, and popular retail stocks exhibit considerable numbers of these tiny trades. We surmise that this reflects dollar-based order entry, with many tiny trades being fractional components of larger orders. We show that our fractional trade measure is predictive of future liquidity and volatility, suggesting a new metric to capture the information in retail trades. We identify how data and reporting protocols preclude knowing the extent of fractional share trading, inflate volume data, and provide censured samples of these off-exchange trades.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究零碎股交易。我们开发了一种基于延迟的方法来识别大量零碎股交易样本。我们发现，高价股、网红股、首次公开募股、特殊目的收购公司和受欢迎的散户股票表现出相当数量的此类微小交易。我们推测这反映了基于美元的订单输入，许多微小交易是较大订单的零碎组成部分。我们表明，我们的零碎交易指标能够预测未来的流动性和波动性，从而提出一种捕捉散户交易信息的新指标。我们识别了数据和报告协议如何阻碍了解零碎股交易的程度，夸大成交量数据，并提供这些场外交易的审查样本。

articles.title_en: Associative memory, beliefs and market interactions
articles.title_cn: 联想记忆、信念与市场互动
articles.abstract_en: Recent theories and narratives highlight the potential role of associative recall in driving overreaction in expectations and market behavior. Based on a simple model, we test this idea through a series of experiments in which news are communicated with memorable contexts. Because the experimental participants predominantly remember those past news that get cued by new information, their beliefs about fundamentals strongly overreact. In a betting market experiment, associative recall translates into overreaction in market prices, which makes realized prices too extreme. Our results highlight the importance of associative memory for beliefs and financial decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期理论和叙事强调联想回忆在推动预期和市场行为过度反应中的潜在作用。基于一个简单模型，我们通过一系列实验来检验这一想法，在这些实验中，新闻以令人难忘的背景进行传达。由于实验参与者主要记住那些被新信息提示的过去新闻，他们对基本面的信念强烈过度反应。在博彩市场实验中，联想回忆转化为市场价格中的过度反应，这使得实际价格过于极端。我们的结果强调了联想记忆对信念和金融决策的重要性。
